notes.title: Bug fix - 0.170
notes.content: [p]Hey guys, [/p][p]just letting you know some of the bugs reported have been squashed. Thank you to everyone for your reports![/p][p][/p][p]This post was supposed to go out yesterday with the release, but I was unfortunately quite tired.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here's a brief changelog below on 0.170 (Mostly bug fixes - SOME quality of life improvements)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]0.170 changelog:[/i][/b][/p][p] - upgraded to renpy 8.4.* (among lotsa other things, that should fix steam achievements not working) [/p][p]- fixed a bug with entering a cheat code and starting a new game potentially leading to steam achievements not working on this save[/p][p] - you can now tell which items are worn by the currently selected char (brighter item frame outline) [/p][p]- fixed auto-pathing: in map navigation, picking "safest" will now also pick the shortest path in case of 2+ equally safe routes [/p][p]- mrs winward' tannery now has an extra line to re-explain what she does, as long as a persistent note on animal hides[/p][p] - fixed marbella's mining shop income after investing, also dropped in a persistent note after investing [/p][p]- fixed wrong sprites in one of the versions of divine bj sex scene[/p][p] - hangings and mad prophet will only cut-in once: then they'll appear as clickable events on Novaras streets [/p][p]- you can't save during a gallery replay scene anymore[/p][p] - improved items' descriptions in combat/story[/p][p] - fixed a bunch of typos & markup errors[/p][p] - there's now more info in error reports [/p][p] -Being able to talk to party characters via characters/inventory screen (work in progress)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562767/ea9885fa9ce4ebea277590c3759ff682c96b4aa4.png"][/img][/p][p][i]That's all for now, spicier and more exciting updates to come![/i][/p][p][b]- Damned Studios[/b][/p]

notes.title: News and schedule tweak
notes.content: [h1]Hey guys! [/h1][h1]Just got a couple of things wanted to discuss with you guys regarding the next update, etc...[/h1][p][/p][p]First and foremost, we've managed to fix the recent bug surrounding the crooked shaft mining co not paying out any cash after investing AND why the steam achievements are currently not working.[/p][p]However, we're having a couple issues with getting together the steam build with the fix, therefore [u]the fix for steam users will be up on Monday - Sorry for any inconvenience.[/u][/p][p][/p][p]Other important news: At the coders request, [b]the tech/QOL update will now be out the 15th of September instead of the end of this month.[/b] This doesn't really affect you guys too much, but just in case anyone was waiting around there on that.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, onto news with the next major update. We're still working on it and gathering the assets. This update WILL continue the main story and further expand the free city of Hamun. I do see people continue to ask if they will get to return to Novaras, not that I like giving spoilers, but yes, rest assured you will get to return and finish up any content there you didn't finish.[/p][p][/p][p][i]This update will also hugely expand upon the lore of the Parasites and more...[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562767/95a46f4e8c67df3d410fbe7bff6e26749fdf7c14.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone for your patience and kind words about the game so far, we do know we've had a bit of a rocky start since making the plunge to steam, but we're doing our best to adapt quickly.[/p][p]If you guys have any questions, please ask them below or over on the discord, and we'll try to answer them as best as we can. [url="https://discord.gg/uMjfkAYMHm"]https://discord.gg/uMjfkAYMHm[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562767/0a0ffb73db3b6346235105a689c497d70ddfe65f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Thank you for your support![/i][/p][p][b]-The Damned Studios Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Parasite Black update plan for 2025!
notes.content: [h1]Hello adventurers! [/h1][p][/p][p]We wanted to take a moment to discuss some important news, changes, and hopefully clear up any misconceptions. [/p][p]Moving forward now, we plan to release a series of smaller, but steady releases as we build upon Act 2, both adding side content and continuing the main story. We think this is an incredibly exciting time to be a fan; it’s a lot of work on our part, but we think we’re building something special. [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]The Release schedule explained:[/b][/u][/p][p]We’d like to take a moment to explain how our release schedule works – This info/dates can be found in a thread for the community to discuss as well.[/p][p]The way our release schedule works is that our patron supporters pay a monthly subscription (with different tiers of financial support) and receive the latest content updates first. These users help us with various bug-fixes so that when it arrives for Steam users, the experience is hopefully much more polished. Steam users then receive the update after. [u]We want to stress that steam users receive ALL the same content[/u]. The tradeoff for steam users is that they only must pay once, but they need to wait a little longer, which we feel is the fairest system for everyone. [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Changes to the schedule:[/b][/u] [/p][p]With that said, after taking on board some feedback. Rather than making steam users wait a full month like with this release just gone, [b]steam players will now receive access to the beta 2 weeks from its beta launch and then access to the finished build one week after that – (3 weeks).[/b][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Current release outline plan for Parasite Black for 2025![/b][/u] [/p][p][i]Please note, all these dates are considered approximate – If there’s any delays for whatever reason, we’ll give the heads-up.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562767/2db82090416c4512f34bf00583a6f28030320b19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Finally, we'd like to thank everyone for your support so far,[/i][/p][p][i]without your incredible support, none of this would be possible,[/i][/p][p][b]-The Damned Studios Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: PARASITE BLACK Act 1 Finale Update is LIVE on Steam!
notes.content:
[p][b]Act 1 Finale update[/b] is now live for all Steam users![/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone for your continued patience during this period. As many of you following closely already know, this update was especially challenging—both due to its sheer scope and a few unavoidable real-life issues that impacted the timeline.[/p][p]That said, we’re proud to say this is [b]one of the biggest updates we’ve ever released[/b]—and it features the [b]first major battle sequence[/b] in the game. We hope you enjoy this exciting, action-packed conclusion to Act 1![/p][p][b]Looking ahead:[/b]
On [b]Monday[/b], after taking in some early feedback, we’ll be announcing several important changes going forward, along with the [b]full update timeline[/b] for the rest of 2025.[/p][p][i]As Novaras braces itself for a terrible battle, our adventurers find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent a terrible Demorai plot from unfolding… Before it’s too late![/i]
[/p][p][b][u]Changelog:[/u][/b][/p][p]New quests:[/p][p]- Best Friend's Path quest: the girl troubles' markus sharing path for mika quest, with sex scenes[/p][p]- all-round improvements to mika training quest[/p][p]- new romance with mika, with multiple sex scenes[/p][p]- Beneath the Shadows: helping out new character, Carina[/p][p]- new brothel locations & characters[/p][p]- sex dungeon summon system with a sex scene for Mika[/p][p]- The Coming Storm, part 1 of act 1 conclusion. Includes sex scenes, characters, battles.[/p][p]- The Judgment Day, part 2 of act 1 conclusion. Also includes new characters, sex scenes, battles.[/p][p]- New party characters, classes and skills[/p][p]- Bunch of new items related to the above quests: weapons, armor & jewelry[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Big changes/additions:[/u][/b][/p][p]- new act 2 city w/ locations & characters.[/p][p]- introduced a save update routine: saves up to version 0.159 (backwards from 0.162) should now be working on ver. 0.162. Perhaps even saves made on earlier versions of the game.[/p][p]- new world travel code and UI:[/p][p]- travel now takes various amounts of time, can be fast-forwarded with ctrl, and much more.[/p][p]- changed/improved all travel maps, added 2 new travel paths[/p][p]- world map indication of paths & your current location[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Smaller fixes/changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]- last selected combat team will now be auto-re-selected if you have more than 4 chars[/p][p]- fixed a bug with shop discount not working properly[/p][p]- Kiara rooftop scene now has a vag/anal choice[/p][p]- fixed double Elena sprites during shared in thorns quest[/p][p]- fixed the gangs' slain button during The Dark Knight to behave less weirdly[/p][p]- fixed tons of typos all over the script[/p][p]- cinematic improvements in script (better char/scene displays)[/p][p]- health/energy bars now change smoothly[/p][p]- fixed softlock during Price of Life quest[/p][p]- fixed softlock during Nyx guard walk-in scene[/p][p]- fixed numerous smaller bugs with battle system[/p][p]- new relationship screen lines & entries for characters[/p][p]- fixed a bug with selection overlap in combat[/p][p]- wrong romance indicator on rel. Screen[/p][p]- lots of other backend improvements, mostly translation-related[/p][p]- added sounds for fire/poison status effects[/p][p]- quest history now has a main indicator and also lists all quests in completion order[/p][p]- fixed skill hit chances to not appear when they're not relevant
[/p][p][b][u]New assets:[/u][/b][/p][p]- better sprites for Regina, Erika, Mika.[/p][p]- new art/anim for divine parasite missionary sex scene[/p][p]- new art/anim for divine parasite standing sex scene[/p][p]- new art/anim for Kiara rooftop scene[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Hotfixes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-fixed a bug with loading a save done mid-travel[/p][p]- fixed a bug with old version gallery unlocks being a list and causing tons of errors on scene unlocks[/p][p]- fixed all game quests to not include a debug quest: the game won't display that 1 extra quest you can't beat anymore[/p][p]- fixed girls troubles' not completing on game load, if already resolved Mika's branch[/p][p]- fixed Mika romance not starting if loading an old save w/girl troubles quest active[/p][p]- made lovers' path / friends' path quests complete the other branch silently: this removes 1 (or two in case of friends path') other hidden quest you can't complete during your playthrough[/p][p]- fixed a few typos[/p][p]- tweaks and bug fixes for numerous battle skills for Kiara's banshee form, Erika's inquisitor class, MC's parasite black class and more: the vampire's song, eye for an eye, inquisition, defender of the weak, parasite attack, prayer for the dying, old gods bargain, a song of pain, a song of vengeance, a song of rage, (Zanarak's) black light, Kiara transform/un-transform[/p][p]- fixed bunch of typos[/p][p]- fixed lots of char sprite positions[/p][p]- fixed nyx dominant scene happening in love route & corresp. gallery scene[/p][p]- lizards encounter size now scales off player party size[/p][p]- fixed a bug with infection death loop[/p][p]- progression fixes to mika questline (mages path, lovers path, lets celebrate)[/p][p]

notes.title: Act 1 Finale Is Almost Here
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re nearly done. The update that finishes Act 1 is locked in and coming soon. We’re not giving an exact date, but it will be out this month. Right now, we’re just fixing the last few things and making sure everything runs smoothly.[/p][p]This update took longer than we’d planned. Some of it was out of our hands issues with one of our artists, staff getting sick, general chaos. You know how it goes.[/p][p]That said, we’ve made some serious changes behind the scenes. Brought in fresh talent, and tightened up our pipeline. notes.title: News and AI
notes.content:
Hey guys, we have a bit of important news to discuss some potential changes coming.

As some of you are aware, recently, one of our artists has been missing. While they have managed to make contact and deliver some work, communication lines with them are very difficult. We have managed to get a hold of them, maybe once or twice a month. We've been holding back on commenting further on the issue in the hopes that it resolves itself soon, but this does seem to potentially be a long-term issue.

Unfortunately, and while I can't delve too deep into their personal issues, for context, they live in a relatively unstable area in one of the south Americas, with both limited internet issues and rampant gang violence that seems to be having a flair up recently.

We've attempted to find an artist to fill in the void while hopefully things settle, and while the art produced was very high quality, unfortunately, for PB we fear it will just create more inconsistencies in the long run.

Furthermore, we're not exactly thrilled at the prospect of kicking someone while they're down, (aka, firing them and replacing them altogether), due to circumstances completely out of their control.

As such, when we did manage to have contact with the artist, with their permission, they agreed to allow us to use AI when necessary, based on their art to create new scenes possibly given the circumstances.

I want to stress that none of the art staff are being let go, in fact, we've hired on MORE art staff recently and their regular work will continue as normal.

Furthermore, any AI art produced, we plan to have the existing artists check it over to ensure it's the highest quality we can get it.

We further hope, of course, this approach will help speed up our production, but we are still entirely committed to delivering the highest quality we can.

We haven't made this decision lightly, we had many internal debates, and we're aware of the sensitive nature of AI, but we hope given the circumstances, and how we're handling things, you and the rest of our fans will be understanding.

If you have any questions, please feel free to ask. If the situation changes for whatever reason, we will let you know.

Thank you.

-The Damned Studios Team
